correctness.rationale: The full PAV score separates into sums of integer-concave f_i(t)=a_i H_t+b_i H_{K-t} for exactly three parties (all ballot types accounted for). Exchange local optimality exactly asserts selected marginal dominance over unselected marginals; the finite marginals decrease, giving global optimality. The m≤2 cases follow similarly. Exact-rational verifier checked 10852 allocation cases plus the previously published four-party obstruction.

value.rationale: This gives the exact model-specific party-count frontier for guaranteed local PAV search in approval-based apportionment, irrespective of electorate size or house size, and provides a constructive marginal-greedy optimum at m≤3. This is motivated by the 2026 work comparing local/global PAV, priceability and core guarantees; the four-party failure is already known and is credited as boundary evidence.
